data.name: TinyCraft Town
data.detailed_description:
🏝️ TinyCraft Town is a simple 2D pixel art survival game focused on light resource management, crafting, and exploration. Gather materials, cook food, fish, build workstations, craft weapons and gear, and restore a small ruined village. Inspired by games like RuneScape, Valheim, and Conan Exiles—without the complexity.

This is a relaxing crafting sim with satisfying progression, cozy visuals, and no pressure — just you, your tools, and a world to rebuild.

🪓 What will you do?

🛠️ Gather & Craft – Chop wood, mine ores, and create workstations and tools to fuel your progress.
🏘️ Rebuild the Town – Fix abandoned buildings to unlock new features, recipes, and characters.
🌱 Explore & Expand – Discover new lands and resources as you repair bridges, docks, and passageways.
📦 Strategic Resource Flow – Optimize your village's productivity and balance your economy.
🎵 Chill Atmosphere – A cozy pixel world with a soothing soundtrack, perfect for relaxed play sessions.
♻️ Early Access Evolving World – Frequent content updates and new systems on the horizon.

If you enjoy games like Forager, Travellers Rest, or Stardew Valley, but want something more focused on crafting and calm progression, TinyCraft Town is the perfect escape.

🧰 Whether you're here to optimize or just to unwind — your village awaits.

Thank you so much for your visit! I'm a solo indie game developer and I am doing my best to improve the game based on the community feedback. By purchasing the game you are encoraging me to keep making games even better. Best wishes!
